summary: Iteration 8 bundle testing complete. All 4 features verified: (1) Speedrun timer HUD renders yellow MM:SS.cc box top-right in-game with 'SPEEDRUN' label and level name; menu toggle highlights yellow when on. (2) Workshop SKINS tab (data-testid=workshop-tab-skins, visible label 'WRENCHES') renders 8 skin cards, equipped 'Standard Wrench' shows yellow EQUIP badge + EQUIPPED label, clicking a locked skin (e.g. Rusty Iron) reveals 'UNLOCK (50 SCRAP)' button (data-testid=workshop-unlock-btn). (3) Achievements modal lists all 15 achievements with '0/15 Unlocked' counter. (4) Claymation enemy sprite (beige clay root_crawler) visible in Level 1 instead of procedural polygons. Backend persistence fields (unlocked_skins, best_run_time_ms, best_l1_time_ms) round-trip correctly via POST /api/progress + GET /api/progress/{id}.

issues: Skins tab button visible label is 'WRENCHES' while the testing request and data-testid use 'skins' — not a bug, just naming inconsistency; consider aligning label to 'SKINS' or documenting as 'WRENCHES = skins'.

passed_tests: Backend pytest 8/8 passed (test_progress_iter8.py): health, root, achievements list has all 15 ids, progress default returns new fields (unlocked_skins=[standard], best_run_time_ms=0, best_l1_time_ms=0), POST+GET round-trip persists wrench_skin=neon, unlocked_skins, best_run_time_ms=185450, best_l1_time_ms=27300, update overwrites previous values, scores endpoint unaffected, enemy sprite files exist (root_crawler.png, gear_bug.png, heavy.png) and flicker.png intentionally absent
Title -> PLAY -> MORE tab -> WORKSHOP opens modal with WRENCHES tab preselected
Workshop 'skins' tab (data-testid=workshop-tab-skins) renders 8 cards: standard, rusty, golden, neon, ember, frost, shadow, scrap_special
Standard Wrench card shows yellow 'EQUIP' badge on thumbnail + 'EQUIPPED' label at bottom
Clicking locked 'Rusty Iron' card reveals 'UNLOCK (50 SCRAP)' button with data-testid=workshop-unlock-btn
Menu MORE -> ACHIEVEMENTS opens modal listing all 15 achievements with 0/15 Unlocked counter (matches progress.achievements)
Play tab SPEEDRUN MODE toggle (data-testid=menu-speedrun-toggle) highlights yellow when enabled (border #FFD60A, text color #FFD60A)

Starting mission with speedrun ON renders yellow timer box top-right showing MM:SS.cc format ticking upward (e.g. 00:03.17), 'SPEEDRUN' label visible, current level name 'Overgrown Outskirts' visible above timer
Level 1 renders claymation-style root_crawler PNG sprite (beige clay creature) instead of procedural red polygons — sprite visible bottom-right of screenshot
Player WASD + SPACE + X controls functional, ESC pauses and shows pause overlay with 'RESUME/PAUSED' text
Zero JavaScript console errors, zero page errors during full session
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: GameProgress and ProgressUpdate models correctly extend with unlocked_skins (default ['standard']), best_run_time_ms and best_l1_time_ms (default 0). Upsert via update_one $set is idempotent. _id is excluded from GET via projection.

Sonner Toaster element (data-sonner-toaster) was NOT found in DOM at inspection time because sonner mounts its ol lazily on first toast — acceptable behavior, not a bug. Toasts will appear when achievements unlock; visual unlock verification requires defeating an enemy in-canvas which cannot be asserted from DOM.

Default-no-achievements state shows '0/15 Unlocked' even though there's no persisted unlock yet — correct; fragment_1 and other condition-triggered toasts will re-seed from progress.achievements to avoid re-firing on reload per the engine.achievements seed path.
Workshop skins tab label renders 'WRENCHES' in UI but data-testid=workshop-tab-skins — cosmetic naming mismatch; consider unifying naming for future test clarity.
HUD timer top-right does not overlap with Score or hearts/scrap meter at 1920x1080 — layout is clean.
action_items: Optional: rename Workshop 'WRENCHES' tab label to 'SKINS' to match testing spec and data-testid.

Optional: when speedrun best-time is set, verify 'Best run: MM:SS.cc • L1: MM:SS.cc' line appears under toggle on Play tab (could not trigger a victory in automated test; needs manual playthrough or seeded progress).

Optional manual verification: defeat first root_crawler in Level 1 to confirm achievement toast pops with gold border top-right (sonner container mounts lazily; DOM check confirms no blocking integration issues).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed progress docs (TEST_default_*, TEST_iter8_*, TEST_update_*) — safe to leave; does not affect 'default' player.
